title: Provable Fairness for Neural Network Models using Formal Verification
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'Provable Fairness,' proposing and evaluating metrics like Weighted Symmetric Difference (WSD) and Net Preference (NP) to address racial and gender bias in neural network models. Since fairness is a core pillar of AI ethics, and the paper evaluates model performance against these ethical constraints, it is categorized as being related to ethics.
